noInvitation: This event has no invitation to design. An event created before any design template existed has none.

overview.title: Design the invitation

state.DRAFT: A draft: guests can’t open it yet.

overview.live: Changes you save show on guests’ pages straight away.
overview.changeLook: Change the template or the look
overview.sectionsLead: In the order guests read them. A hidden section keeps its words and can be shown again.
overview.unknown: This app doesn’t know this section yet, so it can’t be edited here.
overview.cannotShow: This template can’t show this section.
overview.addedStatus: {{name}} added at the end of the page.
overview.addLead: This template can show these too. An added section goes at the end of the page, shown.

hideReply.title: Hide the reply section?
hideReply.body: Guests who open their link will have no way to answer until you show it again. Answers already given are kept.

HERO.name: Cover
HERO.about: The first thing guests see: the names, the occasion and the date, with the cover photo.

STORY.name: Invitation text
STORY.about: Your own words to your guests, with a photo in some layouts.

COUNTDOWN.name: Countdown
COUNTDOWN.about: The time left until the event starts.

MUSIC.name: Music
MUSIC.about: One piece of music. Guests start it themselves: it never plays on its own.

VENUE.name: Venues
VENUE.about: Where it happens: each venue guests are shown, with its address.

MAP.name: Directions
MAP.about: A link to each venue on a map, where it has one.

TIMELINE.name: Running order
TIMELINE.about: What happens when, on the day.

DRESS_CODE.name: Dress code
DRESS_CODE.about: What to wear, with suggested colours.

NOTES.name: Requests
NOTES.about: Short notes for guests, about flowers, photos or children, say.

GALLERY.name: Gallery
GALLERY.about: Photos, in the order you choose.

RSVP.name: Reply section
RSVP.about: Where guests answer. Without it, they have no way to reply.

SIGNATURE.name: Signature
SIGNATURE.about: A closing line, with your signature or monogram.

CHAT.name: Guest chat
CHAT.about: A link to your guests’ group chat.

CONTACT.name: Contact
CONTACT.about: Who guests can call with questions.

help.heroTitle: The names on the cover. Left empty, the hosts’ names from the event are shown.
help.contactTitle: A short label above the contact, such as “Questions?”
help.paragraphs: Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
help.chatUrl: A web link starting with https://

section.isHidden: Hidden: guests don’t see this section.
section.cannotShow: The template {{template}} can’t show this section.
section.missing: The invitation doesn’t have this section yet. Added, it goes at the end of the page, shown.
section.unknown: This app doesn’t know this section yet.

data.venues: The venues come from the event’s venue list, in each guest’s language.
data.timeline: The running order comes from the event itself; it can’t be edited in the app yet.
data.countdown: It counts down to the event’s start, in the event’s time zone.

section.layoutHelp: The preview can’t draw this template’s layouts yet: your choice is kept for when it can.
section.noLayouts: The template’s layouts couldn’t be loaded, so the layout stays as it is.
section.noCopy: No words in this language yet: guests reading it see the default language’s.
section.coloursHelp: Shown as small squares under the dress code. Say in the text what to wear: a colour can’t be read aloud.
section.onlyFirst: Only the first is shown in the {{name}} section.
section.noCandidates: No upload of the right kind yet.
section.savedLive: Saved. Guests see it straight away.
section.nothing: Nothing had changed, so nothing was sent.

look.title: Template and look
look.lead: The template decides which sections the invitation can have, and offers the fonts and colours made for it.
look.standIn: For now, the preview and guests’ pages use Aveline’s own typefaces and colours. The fonts and colours chosen here are kept, and will show once they can be delivered.
look.nothing: Nothing had changed, so nothing was sent.
look.noOthers: There is no other template to choose.
look.templatesRefused: Your role can’t see the templates.
look.showsAll: Can show every section this invitation shows.

switch.title: Use {{name}}?
switch.look: The look goes back to this template’s own: {{look}}.
switch.lookPlain: The look goes back to this template’s own.
switch.hidden: These sections are hidden, keeping their words: {{sections}}.
switch.layouts: These sections go back to the default layout: {{sections}}.
switch.missing: It can also show {{sections}}; you can add them afterwards.
switch.kept: Every section’s words and photos, and every question, are kept.

questions.title: Questions for guests
questions.lead: What the reply form asks, besides whether each guest is coming.
questions.attendance: Whether each guest is coming is always asked.
questions.attributionHelp: Asked only when the event names both sides, and only of guests whose side you haven’t set.
questions.choicesHelp: Give each choice in at least one language: guests reading another see the first one given. The catering and bar sheets count a choice once, whatever the language.
questions.nothing: Nothing had changed, so nothing was sent.
questions.ownLead: In the order guests are asked them.
questions.none: No questions of your own yet.
questions.cannotRemove: Guests have answered it, so it can’t be removed. Make it optional instead.

removeQuestion.title: Remove “{{prompt}}”?
removeQuestion.body: Guests won’t be asked it any more.

question.typeLocked: Guests have answered it, so its kind can’t change.
question.signatureHelp: Guests agree to your wording by typing their name or drawing a signature. Each agreement is kept with the wording it was given to.
question.promptHelp: In at least one language. Guests reading another see the default language’s, or the first one given.
question.choicesHelp: Give each choice in every language you use: a language with some choices missing can’t be saved.
question.answeredChoices: Guests have answered it, so its choices can be reworded, or added at the end, but not removed.
question.gone: This question is no longer on the invitation.

media.title: Photos and music
media.lead: Your uploads for this invitation. A section shows one once you choose it on the section’s page.
media.fileHelp: A JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF picture, or MP3 or M4A music, up to 10 MB.
media.kindHelp: For a picture only. A logo suits a corporate event or a monogram.

problems.type: This kind of file can’t be used. Choose a picture or a music file of a kind listed.
problems.size: This file is larger than 10 MB.

media.refused: Your role can’t see the uploads.
media.cannotRemove: Something shows it, so it can’t be removed. Take it off there first.
media.gone: An upload no longer in your library
media.describeHelp: What the picture shows, for guests who can’t see it, in each language. At most 300 characters.
media.nothing: Nothing had changed, so nothing was sent.

preview.lead: A preview: guests see this once the invitation is published and sent. Nothing is collected here.
preview.sample: With the template’s sample text, not your invitation’s.
preview.otherTemplate: Shown in {{name}}, which this invitation doesn’t use.
preview.chooseIt: Choose it on the template page

problems.forbidden: Your role on this event can see the invitation’s design but not change it. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.check: This couldn’t be saved as it is. Check the fields marked.
problems.stale: The page was out of date, so nothing changed. It has been reloaded: try again.
problems.cannotShow: This template can’t show this section.
problems.sectionMissing: This section is no longer on the invitation. The page has been reloaded.
problems.questionMissing: This question is no longer on the invitation. The page has been reloaded.
problems.mediaMissing: This upload is no longer in the library. The page has been reloaded.
problems.templateMissing: This template is no longer available.
problems.missing: This invitation is no longer available.
problems.answered: Guests have answered this question, so it can’t be removed. Make it optional instead.
problems.orderChanged: The questions changed since this page was loaded, so their order didn’t. The page has been reloaded: try again.
problems.inUse: A section or the public listing still shows this upload, so it can’t be removed. Take it off there first.
problems.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
problems.wrongType: This kind of file can’t be used.
problems.conflict: Something changed meanwhile. The page has been reloaded: try again.

errors.url: Give a web link starting with https:// or http://
errors.noPrompt: Give the wording in at least one language.
errors.noChoices: Give at least one choice, in at least one language.
errors.halfFilled: Give every choice in a language, or none.
errors.halfFilledIn: Give every choice in {{languages}}, or none.
errors.noLabel: Give this choice in at least one language.
errors.labelTooLong: A choice has at most 80 characters.
